answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces superlinear attacker cost via topological cut verifications and stake slashing. Auditor nodes examine trust graphs to spot partition vulnerabilities: like water carving fragile karst caverns, collusion clusters are isolated by minimum cut analysis. Corrupted nodes face harsh stake slashing, weathering a gale of economic penalties. A sentinel raven routing scheme audits independent validation paths, imposing exponential costs on Sybils attempting falsified consensus.
